name: github
title: GitHub
description: Mints a GitHub App installation token for the repositories a run works on, with the permissions the machine allows and no more.

app_id.title: App id
app_id.description: The GitHub App's numeric id, or its client id.

installation_id.title: Installation id
installation_id.description: The App's installation on the account whose repositories runs work on. Absent means it is looked up from the repositories on every call.

permissions.title: Permissions
permissions.description: The most a run's token gets, by GitHub's permission name, of those a run may be granted: read or write, never admin. At least one; absent is the default. Administration, secrets, environments and every organisation's and member's permission are refused.

api_url.title: API
api_url.description: GitHub's API, where the App's own token goes: https://api.github.com, the default, or http or https on a loopback host, 127.0.0.0/8, ::1 or localhost, for a test. GitHub Enterprise Server is not supported.

private_key_file.title: Private key file
private_key_file.description: A file that contains the App's private key and that only its owner reads: the key kept on disk.

private_key.title: Private key
private_key.description: The App's private key, the PEM GitHub hands out. Secret: written, never read back, and never on a command line.
